summary: In the United States, Panobinostat carries a boxed warning for harm to the heart as well as stomach and gut problems [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, estimated medium risk scores of 62 for the liver and 57 for the heart [M]. In addition, a clinical trial studying this drug along with fluorouracil and leucovorin calcium was stopped due to adverse events, meaning harmful side effects [5].
